merchant.description: The store or business name printed on the receipt. "Unknown" if unreadable, "Not a receipt" if the image is not a receipt.

date.description: Purchase date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty string if no date is visible.

total.description: Final amount paid (the grand total), as a plain number with no currency symbol.

category.description: Best-fit expense category for the purchase.

items.description: Every line item on the receipt, in the order printed. One entry per purchased product or service. Empty array if no line items are legible.

description.description: The item name or description exactly as printed on the receipt.

quantity.description: Quantity purchased for this line. Use 1 when no quantity is shown.

price.description: The amount charged for this line (the line total), as a plain number.

confidence.description: Confidence that the extracted fields are correct, from 0.0 to 1.0.
